questions: Should the function preserve trailing newlines in the input string (e.g., a final '\n' after the last line)?
Should the function treat consecutive newlines (empty lines) as separate lines to be wrapped (resulting in empty wrapped lines), or collapse/ignore them?
Does the regex substitution (replacing 'is' with 'was') apply to the entire wrapped string after joining, or per line before joining?
Should the width parameter apply to the maximum line length including whitespace at the start/end of lines, or only to visible characters?
If a line is already shorter than the width, should it be left unchanged (aside from the regex substitution)?
Should the function handle tab characters by expanding them to spaces before wrapping?
Is the regex pattern '\bis\b' case-sensitive? Should it match 'Is' or 'IS'?
Should the function trim leading/trailing whitespace from each line before wrapping?
